title: Sync disabled
symptom: On both the phone (sync master) and tablet (sync follower), the 'Disable all sync features' setting became checked on its own, causing sync to stop. Rebooting the phone restored sync.
cause: The cause is not definitively established. The user suspects a problem with the latest nightly APK, but the maintainer could not see how the code change could enable the setting by itself.
fix: Rebooting the phone restored sync. No other fix was stated.
